description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding ASN.1 structures related to 3GPP F1 Application Protocol (F1AP), including conversions between ASN.1 and internal representations, handling of cause codes, cell identifiers, QoS parameters, and SRS configurations.

methods.name: asn1_to_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 cause_c structure to internal f1ap_cause_t type based on cause type.

methods.name: cause_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal f1ap_cause_t type to ASN.1 cause_c structure.

methods.name: cgi_from_asn1
methods.description: Extracts NR cell global ID from ASN.1 structure, returning a combined PLMN and cell ID.

methods.name: cgi_to_asn1
methods.description: Encodes NR cell global ID into ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: nr_cell_id_from_asn1
methods.description: Creates NR cell identity from ASN.1 NR CGI structure.

methods.name: trp_info_to_asn1
methods.description: Encodes TRP info into ASN.1 structure.
